card.name: Just before 'magnesium' spellings
card.fires_on: The piece right before 'agnes' or 'agnesium' when 'magnesium' is split into parts, as in Hyp-om-agnesemia and aluminum hydroxide-m-agnesium. It also fires on '/Mg' after Al.

modes.label: Hypomagnesemia
modes.description: The 'om' in Hypomagnesemia, in section headings and warnings about low magnesium.

modes.label: Aluminum-magnesium antacids
modes.description: The 'm' or 'Mg' joining aluminum and magnesium in antacid names.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward continuing with 'mag' pieces, completing the word magnesium.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a split-up word where 'magnesium' is about to be completed, as in hypomagnesemia or aluminum-magnesium antacids.
